verses.text: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

verses.text: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.text: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

verses.text: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.text: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.
